solutions.name: Hackian (Ethiack's agentic AI pentesting engine)
solutions.what: AI agent that runs reconnaissance, exploits vulnerabilities with non-destructive routines and reports findings with proof of exploitation; used in Continuous Adversarial Exposure Validation and in Agentic Pentests (Swift, Depth).

solutions.name: Continuous Adversarial Exposure Validation
solutions.what: Always-on test mode in which Hackian runs reconnaissance and broad vulnerability checks across the in-scope attack surface.

solutions.name: Agentic Pentest (Swift, Depth)
solutions.what: On-demand, in-depth test of selected assets by Hackian, governed by a written policy with focus, goals and guardrails.

solutions.name: Expert Pentest
solutions.what: Hackian-led pentest with human ethical hackers, scheduled with the Ethiack team.

solutions.name: Ethiack Beacon
solutions.what: Customer-deployed tunnel that extends Hackian's testing into internal networks.

solutions.name: Attack Surface Management
solutions.what: Continuous discovery and mapping of an organisation's assets.

solutions.name: Ethiack Zero
solutions.what: Public, read-only feed of new vulnerabilities with Ethiack's check and exploit timings, over a REST API and a public MCP server.
